prompts.atk: Cinematic naval warfare, heavy seas crashing against hull of Type 055 Renhai Guided-Missile Cruiser (USA), Vertical Launch System (VLS) cells ignite in rapid salvo sequence, supersonic missiles piercing ocean mist with dazzling orange rocket blast reflecting on seawater.
prompts.def: Naval close-in defense, Phalanx CIWS radar lock-on, 20mm rotary cannon unleashing unbroken stream of red tracer rounds into oncoming anti-ship missile skimming above ocean waves, detonating it into water spray.
prompts.win: Maritime victory, surface radar displays target neutralized, distant enemy warship capsizing with massive water column explosion, Type 055 Renhai Guided-Missile Cruiser maintaining defensive perimeter under sunset sky.
prompts.loss: Catastrophic naval casualty, heavy torpedo hit beneath keel of Type 055 Renhai Guided-Missile Cruiser, violent hull flex and cascading internal electrical failure, emergency damage control alarms sounding as ship lists heavily.
